dct_description_sm: Understanding the general public’s knowledge and perceptions of an issue can help drive action on the part of decision-makers. Such understanding is critical when decision-makers are faced with multiple stakeholders, which is the case with biodiversity conservation issues. We surveyed the Canadian general public using a telephone questionnaire to assess the level of knowledge and perceptions of native wild bee (Hymenoptera: Apoidea: Anthophila) health and conservation.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Examining the Public’s Awareness of Bee (Hymenoptera: Apoidae: Anthophila) Conservation in Canada
pcdm_memberOf_sm: Public Opinion of Bee Conservation in Canada
